modal.title: Do it for me
modal.subtitleFallback: Krama runs these steps for you
modal.signInHint: Krama acts in your own account. You sign in yourself in Krama's browser; Krama keeps the session encrypted and never sees your password.
modal.actsInAccount: Krama acts in your {account} account on this site.
modal.actsInSignedIn: Krama acts in the account it is signed in to on this site.
modal.noValues: This tutorial needs no values from you.
modal.safetyNote: Krama also stops and asks you before any step that could delete, publish or change settings. If a step fails, it stops there; nothing is retried.
